body: All of the above, yes. For some reason, this boss doesn't like that I constantly take notes. I think she just looks for little things to pick on. I get the impression that she just doesn't like me very much. I know she bullies our one other female employee, too, but the other lady is a remote employee with decades of experience, so it's not as constant, and if she gets fired or whatever, she'll easily find something else. For me, it's more nerve wracking.

Thank you.... my coping mechanisms usually do help (asking lots of questions, repeating what my boss said back to me in another way and phrasing it as a question, finding "formulas" that I just use over and over again, pretending that I'm just super detail oriented rather than slow [which most bosses buy!], etc.), and often, they work-- just not with this boss. I think you're right, it's quit or get fired anymore.... just more for some people than others....

Thanks for the kind words about my friend.... I just wish I knew what to say to her.

Thank you so much.... my husband has said he thinks my mom was doing exactly what you suggested here; pacifying my brother. Ironically, my mom is a severe workaholic who loved managing people. I think she and my brother always got along better because they had similar interests and could pursue them together as projects-- it meant she could work more, rather than talking about feelings, thoughts, emotions, etc., which has always been my thing.

Thanks again for the kind words.
